visual_elements.description: MAIN DIAGRAM — multi-head self-attention dataflow for one word (X₂). Top: small segmented output vector labeled Y₁ with dimension tag '1×d'. Arrow down to white red-bordered box 'Linear Transformation [T] dH×d'. Arrow down to pill container labeled 'Concatenated Vector 1×dH' holding 12 cells in 4 color groups of 3 each: Y¹ (orange), Y² (dark gray), Y³ (yellow), Y⁴ (green) — 3 cells per group, per the repeated segment labels Y¹Y¹Y¹ | Y²Y²Y² | Y³Y³Y³ | Y⁴Y⁴Y⁴. Below, five overlapping rounded-rectangle 'head layers' stacked with diagonal offset, back-to-front: h=5 (backmost, largely hidden behind the green-bordered inset panel — its fill color and full extent not clearly visible [?]; its h=5 badge partially occluded by the inset), h=4 (light green), h=3 (light yellow), h=2 (light purple), h=1 (salmon red, front, fully detailed). Each layer carries white pill labels 'Similarity' (all layers), 'Probability'/'Probabilities' (h=2, h=1), 'Weighted SUM' (all layers), and a dark circular badge top-right of the layer reading h=5 (partially occluded by the inset), h=4, h=3, h=2, h=1 (white bold text). Small green-dashed output vectors sit at each layer's top edge feeding the concatenation bar. FRONT LAYER (h=1) internals, left→right: (1) column of four green-dashed input vectors labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (4–5 cells each, approximate); (2) column of four blue boxes 'W_k^0' with adjacent labels K₁, K₂, K₃, K₄; (3) tan/beige 'Dot Product' box containing a bipartite dot-and-line graph (blue dots connected by thin lines), annotated 'K,q' at its top-right; (4) tall pink box 'Scaling by √d' with 'K,q / √d' written above it; (5) tall pink box 'Soft max'; (6) label 'Probabilities' with a small green arrow; (7) white box with blue 'Σ' and label 'Weighted SUM' above; (8) column of labels V₁, V₂, V₃, V₄ each with a red ⊗ (circled-times) multiply symbol and a blue box 'W_v^0'; (9) column of four green-dashed output vectors on the layer's right edge.
visual_elements.position: center-left, occupying ~70% of slide width and ~65% of height

visual_elements.description: INSET BLOCK DIAGRAM (right side, white panel with thick green border) — canonical transformer attention block: top white box 'Linear' → down arrow → white box 'Concat' → three down arrows into a stack of 4 overlapping purple boxes labeled 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' (stack conveys h parallel copies; a small arrow and italic 'h' annotate the stack) → three up arrows from three white boxes each labeled 'Linear' → bottom labels 'V', 'K', 'Q' under the three Linear boxes.

DIMENSION LEGEND (bottom-right corner, green dashed border): a small horizontal vector of 4 yellow cells tagged '1×d', then an orange box 'W', then '=', then a small orange grid (≈4×4 cells, approximate) tagged 'd×d', then '=' result vector tagged '1×d'. Blue caption below: 'd: Embedding Length'.

Thick dark-red curved arrow starting near the highlighted input X₂ (bottom-left), sweeping right and upward to the per-head weight-matrix grid / stacked layers; red bold label along it reads 'H¹ Heads' [?]. A second short solid red arrow points from below into the pink-highlighted X₂ cell of the bottom-left input box.
3×3 GRID OF WEIGHT MATRICES: nine blue rounded boxes with white text, rows: W_q¹ W_k¹ W_v¹ / W_q² W_k² W_v² / W_q³ W_k³ W_v³ (superscripts 1,2,3 = heads; subscripts q,k,v = projection type).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with black bold '44' at top-right corner.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations; the slide is entirely composed of vector shapes: rounded layer rectangles, dashed-border vector boxes, colored cell strips, circular badges, arrows, and one green-framed inset panel.
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Title bold, ~26–30pt, black, with red 'X₂' subscript. Subtitle bold with blue quoted 'Wide'. All diagram labels small (~9–12pt); layer pill labels and box labels regular weight; badges (h=1..h=5, with the h=5 badge partially occluded by the inset panel) and '44' bold white/black respectively; 'Dot Product', 'Scaling by √d', 'Soft max' set vertically (rotated 90°) inside tall boxes; 'd: Embedding Length' bold blue; weight-matrix text white on blue. Heavy use of subscripts/superscripts throughout (X₁..X₄, K₁..K₄, V₁..V₄, W_k^0, W_v^0, W_q^1..3).
